title: provider-auth -01: Implementation Status gets the Haven/mimid hackathon interop
description: Record in the Implementation Status section (RFC 7942 style): at the IETF 127 hackathon Haven's hub signed requests with the key at haven1._mimi.mimi.havenmessenger.com and mimid verified with DNSSEC; Haven's hub now also verifies signed requests alongside PKIX client certificates against configured CAs (§7), with the authenticated domain tied to From (§10). Key result: no trust anchor exchanged between the two providers, which is the problem mimi-protocol #218 describes. Confirm wording and contact with Jason before posting. Source: Jason Bolduc's review on mimi@ietf.org, 15 Nov 2026 (Message-ID CA+7d1z=LQ+iuYYum-z-SUssV8X5PJgeZL7EW5R2f0Jd4FkzTvA@mail.gmail.com); Mark committed to it publicly in his reply of 16 Nov (IETF notes/2026-11-16-mimi-provider-auth-jason-reply-sent.md). Draft source: ~/PROJECT/ietf-mimi-provider-auth/draft-atwood-mimi-provider-auth.md.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation Status lists Haven and mimid with the interop result, confirmed by Jason.
notes: Draft text in ietf-mimi-provider-auth 7-line Haven entry + interop paragraph (commit after 081187c). Needs Jason's confirmation of wording before posting -01; no message sent.
